name: agent-memory
description: Persistent scoped Agent Memory with focused startup recall, explicit write boundaries, graph tools, and a local dashboard.

interface.shortDescription: Focused durable memory with explicit read/write boundaries
interface.longDescription: A persistent memory plugin for Codex. Its using-agent-memory skill performs focused context reads only when prior knowledge can change the task, treats memory writes as explicit state changes, and stores durable global preferences or project workflows. The MCP also supports deep/lite memory, graph-expanded query, pathfinding, health/prune maintenance, semantic search, model-gated writes, credential setup, and a local read-only dashboard.
defaultPrompt: Use $using-agent-memory to read relevant repo memory
Use $using-agent-memory to save this durable project convention
